directions: In a large skillet, crisp bacon. Remove bacon and cook onion in the bacon fat until golden.
Add flour, sugar, salt, celery seed, and pepper. Cook over low heat until bubbly.
Stir in water and vinegar. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Crumble bacon and add along with potatoes. Heat through, coating all potatoes. Serve warm.
